title: Starlight field
description: A white floor under a clear moonless night at 45° N, lit only by the catalogue's stars (83,479 to V 9, point lights), the Milky Way and airglow. The sky is at its real brightness (default sun intensity) and auto exposure and the Eyes look bring it up to what a dark-adapted eye sees. Used by tools/oracle.py for star light sampling and the camera's star cone.
